info.title: TRUST MARK API
info.description: Brand compliance backend. Authenticate with a Bearer JWT or tm_session cookie. Cookie mutations require X-CSRF-Token matching tm_csrf. Organization membership and verified email are checked on every tenant request. Content is plain text. Scan results never approve content.
